Common reprints in worn condition, no first editions or dust jackets seen.

viewing_check: Estimate $15-30, current bid $5, 22% premium. Only real check is the Kipling: pull 'Captains Courageous' from the stack and look at the binding and title page (Macmillan 1897, blue pictorial gilt cloth, all edges gilt = first; anything else = reprint). Also read the 6 unreadable stacked spines and the 3 monogrammed decorated-cloth volumes, and check flyleaves for signatures or inscriptions. Otherwise treat as a cheap filler lot.
